title: Insurance QA MCP Server - Model Context Protocol for QA Automation
description: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that extends AI assistants with QA automation tools for insurance domains. 10 tools for test execution, data generation, code analysis, and insurance validation. 4 resources for project scanning and domain knowledge. 3 prompt templates. Built with the official MCP Python SDK.
features: 10 MCP tools: run_tests, generate_test_data, lint_code, validate_claim, validate_policy, find_flaky_tests, analyze_coverage, suggest_tests, check_test_health, generate_bdd_scenarios
4 MCP resources: projects list, coverage data, insurance lines, test patterns
3 MCP prompts: review failures, plan test strategy, triage bug
Full Claude Code ecosystem: CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills, agents, commands, rules
P&C insurance domain validation for 8 lines of business
